# ---------------------------------------------------------
# principale function
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_class_barplot <- function(rds_file, output_prefix = "phyloseq_plot") {
  
  # 1. upload phyloseq
  ps <- readRDS(rds_file)
  
  # check
  if (!inherits(ps, "phyloseq")) {
    stop(paste(rds_file, "n'est pas un objet phyloseq valide."))
  }
  
  # Replace "Unknown" par "Unclassified" in tax_table
  tax_mat <- as.matrix(tax_table(ps))
  tax_mat[tax_mat == "Unknown"] <- "Unclassified"
  tax_table(ps) <- tax_table(tax_mat)
  
  if (!"Category" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
    stop("La variable 'Category' est absente dans sample_data(ps).")
  }
  
  if (!"HostSpecies" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
    stop("La variable 'HostSpecies' est absente dans sample_data(ps).")
  }
  
  if (!"Locality" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
    stop("La variable 'Locality' est absente dans sample_data(ps).")
  }
  
  if (!"Class" %in% rank_names(ps)) {
    stop("Le rang taxonomique 'Class' n'existe pas dans cet objet.")
  }
  
  # 2. merge at class level
  ps_class <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Class", NArm = FALSE)
  
  # 3. Transform in relative abundance
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_class, function(x) x / sum(x))
  
  # 4. Convert in long data.frame
  df <- psmelt(ps_rel)
  
  # 5. Managing unassigned classes
  df$Class <- as.character(df$Class)
  df$Class[is.na(df$Class) | df$Class == ""] <- "Unclassified"
  
  # 6. build sample metadata table
  sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rel))
  sample_df$Sample <- rownames(sample_df)
  
  # Force Category order
  sample_df$Category <- factor(sample_df$Category, levels = c("Invasive", "Native"))
  
  # Order by Category, then by HostSpecies and finally by Sample
  sample_df <- sample_df %>%
    arrange(Category, HostSpecies, Locality, Sample)
  
  # Sample final order
  sample_order <- sample_df$Sample
  
  # Apply the order
  df$Sample <- factor(df$Sample, levels = sample_order)
  sample_df$Sample <- factor(sample_df$Sample, levels = sample_order)
  
  # 7. Category color
  label_colors <- ifelse(sample_df$Category == "Native", "blue",
                         ifelse(sample_df$Category == "Invasive", "red", "black"))
  
  # 8. X axes labels = HostSpecies + locality
  new_labels <- paste0(sample_df$HostSpecies, "-", sample_df$Locality)
  
  axis_labels <- paste0(
    "<span style='color:", label_colors, ";'>",
    new_labels,
    "</span>"
  )
  names(axis_labels) <- as.character(sample_df$Sample)
  
  # 9. Plot with HostSpecies-Locality labels 
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Class)) +
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      width = 0.9,
      colour = "grey30"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Class relative abundance for", output_prefix),
      x = "",
      y = "Relative abundance",
      fill = "Class"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 9bis. 2nd plot with pools / samples names
  pool_labels <- paste0(
    "<span style='color:", label_colors, ";'>",
    as.character(sample_df$Sample),
    "</span>"
  )
  names(pool_labels) <- as.character(sample_df$Sample)
  
  p_pools <- p +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = pool_labels) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Class relative abundance for", output_prefix, "- pool names")
    )
  
  # 10. Save
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_prefix, "_class_barplot.png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 14,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_prefix, "_class_barplot_pool_names.png"),
    plot = p_pools,
    width = 14,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(list(
    metadata_labels = p,
    pool_labels = p_pools
  ))
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Apply to both data set
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_16S <- plot_class_barplot(
  rds_file = "Clean_phyloseq_16S.rds",
  output_prefix = "16S"
)

p_OL4 <- plot_class_barplot(
  rds_file = "Clean_phyloseq_OL4.rds",
  output_prefix = "OL4"
)

print(p_16S$metadata_labels)
print(p_16S$pool_labels)

print(p_OL4$metadata_labels)
print(p_OL4$pool_labels)
